verses.text: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: “Keep all the commandments I am giving you today.

xrefs.text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.
Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances. You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.text: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.

xrefs.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the LORD said to Joshua,

just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses: “an altar of uncut stones on which no iron tool has been used.” And on it they offered burnt offerings to the LORD, and they sacrificed peace offerings.
And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it,

verses.text: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

xrefs.text: And there in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua inscribed on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.
And they gave this account to Moses: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!

verses.text: And when you have crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you are to coat them with plaster.

xrefs.text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

verses.text: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You must not use any iron tool on them.

xrefs.text: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.
And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
And Elijah took twelve stones, one for each tribe of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come and said, “Israel shall be your name.”

verses.text: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God.

xrefs.text: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
Then the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

verses.text: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.

xrefs.text: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,
[“]If one’s offering is a peace offering and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he must present it without blemish before the LORD.
Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your households shall eat and rejoice in all you do, because the LORD your God has blessed you.

verses.text: And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.”

xrefs.text: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.

verses.text: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel: “Be silent, O Israel, and listen! This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.

xrefs.text: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances. You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul.
Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.

verses.text: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today.”

xrefs.text: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
For it is your own eyes that have seen every great work that the LORD has done.

verses.text: On that day Moses commanded the people:
“When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

xrefs.text: When this was reported to Jotham, he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim, raised his voice, and cried out: “Listen to me, O leaders of Shechem, and may God listen to you.
She named him Joseph, and said, “May the LORD add to me another son.”
See, today I am setting before you a blessing and a curse—
And with her last breath— for she was dying— she named him Ben-oni. But his father called him Benjamin.

verses.text: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben, for she said, “The LORD has seen my affliction. Surely my husband will love me now.”

verses.text: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite:

xrefs.text: All Israel has transgressed Your law and turned away, refusing to obey Your voice; so the oath and the curse written in the Law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, because we have sinned against You.
For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts.

He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image— an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman— and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves.
You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
[“]You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.
You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must keep My Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.
If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and does not listen to them when disciplined,
Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
Father and mother are treated with contempt. Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker, which was set up by your ancestors to mark the inheritance you shall receive in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed.
Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
I served as eyes to the blind and as feet to the lame.
Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.
He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
Israel’s watchmen are blind, they are all oblivious; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they are dreamers lying around, loving to slumber.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
Do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless, and do not take a widow’s cloak as security.
You shall not follow the crowd in wrongdoing. When you testify in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd.
You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
A wicked man takes a covert bribe to subvert the course of justice.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: A man is not to marry his father’s wife, so that he will not dishonor his father’s marriage bed.
You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.
If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: You must not lie carnally with any animal, thus defiling yourself with it; a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it; that is a perversion.
If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
Whoever lies with an animal must surely be put to death.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law; and yet another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.
After some time, David’s son Amnon fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of David’s son Absalom.
So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was lying down. She took some dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked them.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.

You must not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives; it is depraved.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
And if a man takes the life of anyone else, he must surely be put to death.
“Are you well, my brother?” Joab asked Amasa. And with his right hand Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard to kiss him.

Why then have you despised the command of the LORD by doing evil in His sight? You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own. You have slain him with the sword of the Ammonites.
You shall not murder.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.
Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.

verses.text: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

xrefs.text: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.

But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and practices iniquity, committing the same abominations as the wicked, will he live? None of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness and sin he has committed, he will die.
